welcomeBody: Thirty seconds, once. It matters what this app is and is not.
whatItIsBody: A fast way to look up what published veterinary authorities say about a food, plant or product — and to reach someone who can actually help.
whatItIsNotBody: It is not a vet, not a diagnosis and not an emergency service. Every answer shows where it came from, and every serious answer points you to a professional.
aiConsentBody: If you add a photo, it is sent to an AI service to work out what is in it. The AI never decides whether something is harmful — that comes from our reviewed list. Photos are not stored by us and are not used to train the model.
aiConsentDeclineNote: Declining leaves a fully working app: typed lookups, every verdict and every emergency number. You can change this later in Settings.
